description: This is a PHP source file defining the 'Category' class within the Opencart namespace, specifically for the product category controller. The class handles listing categories, retrieving category information, handling URL parameters for sorting, filtering, pagination, and generating view data for display, including products and subcategories.

classes.name: Category
